While your boyfriend’s reaction—suggesting a breakup over weekend childcare—may seem extreme, his discomfort stems from feeling overwhelmed by additional responsibilities without adequate support or negotiation. His argument that he works long hours to support you and your son is valid, and his request for time to relax and attend football games (where you’re not present) is reasonable.

Your frustration is understandable, but the way you framed the request—accusing him of not being "part of this family" and implying he wasn’t contributing—likely escalated tensions.
